sections.heading: Arts & Sciences Curriculum
sections.text: The College of Arts and Sciences curriculum provides you with an academic framework for becoming an educated and successful citizen of the 21st century. Its flexible structure is designed to inspire curiosity and frame opportunities while drawing you toward two distinct goals: general education across the wide range of the arts and sciences and specialized education in a major. With help from academic advisors, you will select from a variety of courses to fulfill each element of the curriculum. You may also choose to expand your academic experience beyond the classroom through options like research or study abroad.

sections.heading: Bachelor of Arts & Sciences Requirements
sections.text: There are five requirements for the Bachelor of Arts & Sciences in the College. Students fulfill all five requirements throughout their undergraduate career at Penn.
